statement: Introduce loss components by their physical cause (conductor current produces copper loss, alternating flux density in laminations produces iron loss, the field reaching conductive magnets induces magnet eddy currents), not as a bare list; a split into fundamental and switching-frequency parts follows from the two sources in the current and field, not from an analysis purpose ("to separate").
why: The cause explains why the component exists.
provenance: writing-style rule 28; user ruling 2026-11-10 (loss components from physics)
